d: Dr. Do suddenly visits Doldam Hospital and is on bad terms with Dr. Woo Jin. The main hospital organizes and sends a fact-finding committee to Doldam to investigate the table death which occurred during the procedure led by Director Park. Nurse Joo suspects the relationship between Ah Reum and In Beom as they look very close to each other.

Moon Jung's father comes to the hospital, and he says something unexpected to Woo Jin. And Woo Jin hears about the shocking truth about Woo Jin's father from Moon Jung. Eun Jae gets a call from the main hospital to return. Director Yeo says goodbye to people at Doldam Hospital. Min Kook leaves after the incident, but Dr. Kim tries to bring him back.
